Chapter 6836: Where Is Gu Chun

Chapter 6836: Where Is Gu Chun

“That means nothing in the return of the progenitor.” The wolf disagreed.

“Isn’t your progenitor Mang?” Goldsilver blurted.

Listeners became emotional upon hearing this.

“Isn’t Mang already dead?” Thunder Emperor said softly.

“Everything will come to light soon enough. Fallen Ten will take over Stygian and then all of Heavenrealm.” Depravity laughed.

At the very least, their faction’s success consoled their inevitable death.

“Mang is still alive?” The defenders turned pale.

Mang, the founder of Devouring Alliance, ended Mortal Golden World. They reached an unimaginable height during their prime.

“Immortal Emperor Min Ren killed him, the dead can’t return.” Thunder said.

“Heavenrealm will tremble before our coming...” The wolf declared.

“You won’t be able to see that day, so don’t worry about it.” Li Qiye interrupted their fantasy: “Plus, you think too highly of this progenitor and your alliance. They won’t amount to anything in the present Heavenrealm.”

“Our progenitor is a celestial immortal, a godly being...” Absolute shouted.

“Not even a true immortal can save your alliance since I’m here. I will turn your alliance into history.” He said.

Although they wanted to argue, they saw how he took them down without lifting a finger.

“Where is Gu Chun?” Li Qiye asked Dark Emissary.

“Don’t know.” He responded.

“Really now?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I really do not.” He met Li Qiye’s gaze.

“Haha, Gu Chun is always hiding because his reign is illegitimate, he’s afraid of other immortals ambushing him.” The wolf added.

Fallen Ten and Devouring Abyss has never accepted Dark Realm or Immortal Emperor Gu Chun. They considered him an outsider who took over their faction.

“I know a bit about this.” Primal Eagle chimed in.

“Go on.” Li Qiye said.

“Only if you let me leave this place alive.” He shamelessly begged.

“Impossible. Of course, I can find out everything you know even if you don’t tell me.” Li Qiye said.

His expression changed, aware of what Li Qiye could do. Of course, this process would be rather unpleasant.

“Immortal Emperor Gu Chun is not in Dark Realm, Skyshroud isn’t in Stygian either.” The eagle revealed everything.

“Nonsense.” Dark Emissary spoke out.

“It’s true, you all follow the rules even when Gu Chun is not here, haha.” The eagle said.

“Why is Skyshroud not here? He’s the guarantor.” The wolf didn’t believe it either.

Skyshroud was once the pillar of Devouring Alliance after Heaven Pit, saving them from destruction. Later on, he supported the spread of Gu Chun’s Dark Desire.

“Skyshroud has always been here.” Depravity didn’t buy it either.

“I’m telling the truth.” The eagle got his information from Devouring Abyss.

“How do you know?” Dark Emissary asked.

“Haha, we’re just fodders, the two primordial immortals will definitely not show up. We have to accept our fate.” The eagle laughed.

The others became dejected. Was this the end for the alliance and Stygian? No one trustworthy was around.

“Looks like you all have nothing I want to know. I’ll send you on your way then.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Make it quick.” The wolf said.

“I don’t think I will.” Li Qiye shook his head: “You all have devoured worlds, so I must return your strength and vitality to Golden Lamp and its inhabitants.”

They turned pale upon hearing the potential prolonged outcome.

“At least give us face.” Dark Emissary asked for something else - a less pathetic way to die.
